description: A braceless `if (c) a; else b` inside a `!{}` handler-arm body keeps its `else` (S437: the shared statement parser's braceless-else fix). With `mid == "missing"` the `yes` branch runs, not `no`, then the following statement appends `!`.
rationale: §17 if/else — an `else` belongs to the nearest unmatched braceless `if`; §19 `!{}` arm bodies are logic statement lists.
